mapper.select: select id, username, password, display_name, phone, warehouse_id, status, last_login_at, created_at, updated_at from sys_user where username = #{username} limit 1
select id, username, password, display_name, phone, warehouse_id, status, last_login_at, created_at, updated_at from sys_user where id = #{id} limit 1

select u.id, u.username, u.display_name, u.phone, u.warehouse_id, coalesce(group_concat(distinct r.role_code order by r.id separator ','), '') as role_codes, coalesce(group_concat(distinct r.role_name order by r.id separator ','), '') as role_names, w.warehouse_name, u.status, date_format(u.last_login_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as last_login_at from sys_user u left join sys_user_role ur on u.id = ur.user_id left join sys_role r on ur.role_id = r.id left join warehouse w on u.warehouse_id = w.id group by u.id, u.username, u.display_name, u.phone, u.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name, u.status, u.last_login_at order by u.id asc

select count(*) from ( select u.id, u.username, u.display_name, u.phone, coalesce(group_concat(distinct r.role_code order by r.id separator ','), '') as role_codes, coalesce(group_concat(distinct r.role_name order by r.id separator ','), '') as role_names, w.warehouse_name, u.status, u.last_login_at from sys_user u left join sys_user_role ur on u.id = ur.user_id left join sys_role r on ur.role_id = r.id left join warehouse w on u.warehouse_id = w.id group by u.id, u.username, u.display_name, u.phone, w.warehouse_name, u.status, u.last_login_at ) data
where data.username like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or data.display_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or ifnull(data.phone, '') like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or ifnull(data.role_codes, '') like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or ifnull(data.role_names, '') like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or ifnull(data.warehouse_name, '') like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or ifnull(data.status, '') like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or ifnull(date_format(data.last_login_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), '') like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')
select count(*) as totalUsers, sum(case when status = 'ACTIVE' then 1 else 0 end) as activeUsers from sys_user
mapper.insert: insert into sys_user ( username, password, display_name, phone, warehouse_id, status ) values ( #{username}, #{password}, #{displayName}, #{phone}, #{warehouseId}, #{status} )
mapper.select: select ( (select count(1) from sensor_data where created_by = #{userId}) + (select count(1) from grain_temp_record where created_by = #{userId}) + (select count(1) from prediction_task where requested_by = #{userId}) )
select count(distinct u.id) from sys_user u join sys_user_role ur on u.id = ur.user_id join sys_role r on ur.role_id = r.id where u.status = 'ACTIVE' and r.role_code = #{roleCode}
